Upright Piano KW (the tablet's piano sound, upright-piano-kw-v1.sf2)
====================================================================

Not part of this repository and not bundled in the app: the app downloads it on
demand, from this project's GitHub release "models", when someone chooses
Download on Piano > Playback > TABLET SOUND (or on Now playing), and checks its
SHA-256 before it is used.

Source:  FreePats project, "Upright Piano KW", version 2022-02-21: the SoundFont 2
         file UprightPianoKW-20220221.sf2 in the archive
         https://freepats.zenvoid.org/Piano/UprightPianoKW/UprightPianoKW-SF2-20220221.7z
         (archive SHA-256 17c084c6e4205233dc49b34e4bc44a9b2d7c7a2c02b04729ecda77079b07c826),
         described at https://freepats.zenvoid.org/Piano/acoustic-grand-piano.html#UprightKW.
         Created from a Kawai upright piano, recorded by Gonzalo and Roberto
         (roberto@zenvoid.org) in January 2017 with a Zoom H1 in front of the
         piano; the recordings cropped, edited and processed by Roberto. Stereo,
         two velocity layers, 44.1 kHz, 16-bit; bass notes contain loops.

Licence: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication),
         https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. The archive's own
         copy of the legal code is LICENSE.txt beside this file; the archive's
         readme says: "Published under the terms of Creative Commons CC0 public
         domain dedication".

Changes: none. upright-piano-kw-v1.sf2 is UprightPianoKW-20220221.sf2 byte for
         byte (57,377,848 bytes, SHA-256
         d9f5157720963671906727ca2e12b3293fd822c831bb0de477dd1c5f3ad37108),
         renamed. tools/studio/publish_models.py fetches it from FreePats, checks
         both hashes and publishes it.

CC0 asks for no attribution; the app credits it all the same, in About ("Piano
sound: Upright Piano KW, FreePats (CC0)"), in AUTHORS and in the README. The
MIT licence of this project does not apply to it.
